headline: Microsoft plans to add Excel Canvas during October, a tool where its Copilot AI turns spreadsheet data into a report with charts and key figures.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a new Copilot feature for a very widely used spreadsheet, but modest in effect and rolling out gradually.
importance_line: Office workers who build regular reports could save time, but the result depends on Copilot choosing sensible charts and numbers, and Microsoft has pulled back an earlier Excel Copilot feature, so lasting use is unproven.
summary: The Register reports that Microsoft will roll out Excel Canvas through October, a feature in which Copilot builds a report of charts, key numbers and written insights from a workbook and updates it by itself when the data changes. Users need access to Copilot in Excel and can adjust the report by typing requests, and The Register notes that Microsoft dropped another Excel Copilot feature, the COPILOT() formula, in August 2026.
notes: Announcement date not stated; published 2 Oct 2026, treated as new today.
